name: The Ritz-Carlton, Portland
positioning: Downtown Portland, Oregon hotel with a 19th-floor infinity pool and spa, and a 20th-floor restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Portland base with skyline and Cascade Range views
Guests who like a dining-and-cocktails scene in the hotel, with Pacific Northwest and Japanese-inspired menus

facts.text: The hotel is centrally located in Portland, Oregon, with views of the city skyline and the Cascade Range.
The Hidden Mountain Lake Infinity Pool is on the 19th floor, alongside the spa and fitness facility.
Bellpine, on the 20th floor, serves Mexican-inspired Pacific Northwest cuisine.
Meadowrue serves Japanese-inspired bites and a 12-course Omakase tasting menu.
Meadowrue offers weekend live music and seasonal outdoor patio seating.
The spa has saunas, eucalyptus steam rooms, snow showers, a relaxation lounge, a nail salon and a retail boutique.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Portland earned a 2026 Forbes Travel Guide 4-Star rating.
Condé Nast Traveler describes it as the first Ritz-Carlton in the Pacific Northwest.
Powell's bookstore is a four-minute walk from the hotel.

highlights.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is inspired by Multnomah Falls and sits 18 stories above downtown Portland.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a hidden bar beside a billiards table.
The Hidden Mountain Lake Infinity Pool is on the 19th floor, alongside the spa and fitness facility.
Bellpine, on the 20th floor, serves Mexican-inspired Pacific Northwest cuisine.
Meadowrue serves Japanese-inspired bites and a 12-course Omakase tasting menu.

considerations.text: Club Lounge access requires a Club upgrade, and Bonvoy Elite Status does not include it.
Pool access is reserved exclusively for hotel guests, and an appointment is required at the spa.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack resort-style outdoor amenities.
